rationale.conceptual: Method is a routine DFT GGA-PBE band structure calculation with biaxial strain applied via standard lattice parameter changes; no new theory or complex algorithm, but careful convergence and orientation required.
rationale.execution: Pipeline involves optimizing unstrained cell, then 9 strain relaxations with band structure calculations, plus optical spectra for 3 strains, all orchestrated via Quantum ESPRESSO; moderate multi-step engineering but no complex data assembly.

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT band structure and optical property calculation of a 46-atom Si clathrate under biaxial strain, using GGA-PBE. The method is well-established and the pipeline involves sequential relaxations and post-processing, with moderate resource needs.

compute_estimate.reasoning: 46-atom unit cell DFT with PBE, moderate cutoff (480 eV) and k-points (6x6x6 for SCF, 14x14x14 for optics); runs comfortably on a multi-core CPU with a few GB RAM, no GPU required.
